facts.fact: Kayanza commune's administrator said the e-Taxe application was introduced into the commune's tax collection; what it records is not stated.

Only Kayanza commune is named as collecting with the e-Taxe application; the article gives no total of communes using it (Burundi has no count stated here); in Ruyigi, traders pay communal taxes by mobile phone because no Bancobu branch is near the market.
